# PR Review

## Technical Comments

Describe observations related to implementation quality, performance, security, validations, error handling, or maintainability.

---

## Suggestions

Provide any improvement suggestions or possible refactors (if applicable).

---

## Architecture Observations

Confirm whether the implementation follows the agreed project architecture and coding patterns.

* [ ] Follows project architecture
* [ ] Uses proper separation of concerns
* [ ] Maintains consistency with existing modules

Additional comments:

---

## Logical Validation

Confirm whether the solution correctly solves the issue requirements and behaves as expected.

* [ ] Functionality works correctly
* [ ] UI/UX behaves as expected
* [ ] Edge cases were considered
* [ ] No blocking issues found

Additional comments:

---

## Final Decision

* [ ] Approved
* [ ] Changes Requested
* [ ] Commented
